name: marfa
title: Marfa
description: Capture notes to Marfa and browse what every app wrote there
author: aic

commands.name: browse
commands.title: Browse
commands.subtitle: Marfa
commands.description: Browse and search your Marfa items; open, edit, tag, archive, reply to, annotate, trash or delete them

commands.name: quick-capture
commands.title: Quick Capture
commands.subtitle: Marfa
commands.description: Capture a note, or any type the server holds, in a form built from its schema

commands.name: clipboard-capture
commands.title: Clipboard Capture
commands.subtitle: Marfa
commands.description: Capture the clipboard at once: a file, an image, a link as a bookmark, or text as a note

commands.name: clipboard-capture-edit
commands.title: Clipboard Capture (Edit)
commands.subtitle: Marfa
commands.description: Shape the clipboard in a capture form for any type before it is saved

commands.name: type-registry
commands.title: Type Registry
commands.subtitle: Marfa
commands.description: Every type the server holds, and the fields each one declares

commands.name: manage-keys
commands.title: Manage Keys
commands.subtitle: Marfa
commands.description: List, mint, change and revoke the server's API keys, with a key holding keys.mint or the operator key

commands.name: status
commands.title: Status
commands.subtitle: Marfa
commands.description: Check the server, its contract and the API key

tools.name: search-items
tools.title: Search Items
tools.description: Full-text search across the person's Marfa items, returning each item's name, text and tags.

tools.name: list-items
tools.title: List Items
tools.description: The person's most recently changed Marfa items, newest first, narrowed by type, state or tier.

tools.name: capture-item
tools.title: Capture Item
tools.description: Save an item of any type the person's Marfa server holds: a note, a bookmark, a task, an event or any other.

tools.name: list-types
tools.title: List Types
tools.description: The types the person's Marfa server holds, or one type's fields and what each requires.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: A key minted for Raycast, for example with `marfa keys create`

preferences.name: defaultCaptureType
preferences.title: Default Capture Type
preferences.description: The type Quick Capture starts on, as a type identifier such as core.note or core.task

preferences.name: defaultTier
preferences.title: Default Tier
preferences.description: Where captures land: the library keeps what you chose to keep, the feed holds what arrives in volume

preferences.name: defaultTags
preferences.title: Default Tags
preferences.description: Comma-separated tags every capture starts with
